# Capital Claims Tax Depreciation

> > Australia's leading quantity surveyor firm specializing in ATO-compliant tax depreciation schedules and capital allowance reporting for residential and commercial property investors.

Capital Claims provides expert tax depreciation services across Australia, helping property investors maximize legitimate tax deductions through detailed depreciation schedules prepared by qualified AIQS quantity surveyors. The firm serves residential, commercial, and hospitality property sectors with Division 40/43 compliant reports.
